overworld.getDataStorage().computeIfAbsent(TYPE);\n    }\n\n    public static CheckinData get(ServerPlayer player) {\n        return get(player.level().getServer());\n    }\n\n    public synchronized SignInResult signIn(UUID playerId, long day) {\n        PlayerRecord record = players.computeIfAbsent(playerId, ignored -> new PlayerRecord());\n        if (record.signedDays.contains(day)) {\n            return new SignInResult(false, getStats(playerId, day));\n        }\n\n        int ordinal = dailySigners.merge(day, 1, Integer::sum);\n        record.signedDays.add(day);\n        record.signInOrdinals.put(day, ordinal);\n        record.totalDays++;\n        record.streakDays = record.lastSignedDay == day - 1 ? record.streakDays + 1 : 1;\n        record.lastSignedDay = day;\n        setDirty();\n        return new SignInResult(true, new PlayerStats(true, ordinal, record.totalDays, record.streakDays));\n    }\n\n    public synchronized PlayerStats getStats(UUID playerId, long day) {\n        PlayerRecord record = players.get(playerId);\n        if (record == null) {\n            return new PlayerStats(false, dailySigners.getOrDefault(day, 0) + 1, 0, 0);\n        }\n        boolean signed = record.signedDays.contains(day);\n        int ordinal = signed\n                ? record.signInOrdinals.getOrDefault(day, dailySigners.getOrDefault(day, 1))\n                : dailySigners.getOrDefault(day, 0) + 1;\n        int visibleStreak = signed || record.lastSignedDay == day - 1 ? record.streakDays : 0;\n        return new PlayerStats(signed, Math.max(ordinal, 1), record.totalDays, visibleStreak);\n    }\n\n    public synchronized boolean hasSigned(UUID playerId, long day) {\n        PlayerRecord record = players.get(playerId);\n        return record != null && record.signedDays.contains(day);\n    }\n\n    private static CheckinData fromTag(CompoundTag root) {\n        CheckinData data = new CheckinData();\n        CompoundTag playerTags = root.getCompoundOrEmpty(PLAYERS_KEY);\n        for (String key : playerTags.keySet()) {\n            try {\n                UUID playerId = UUID.fromString(key);\n                CompoundTag playerTag = playerTags.getCompoundOrEmpty(key);\n                PlayerRecord record = new PlayerRecord();\n                for (long day : playerTag.getLongArray(\"signed_days\").orElseGet(() -> new long[0])) {\n                    record.signedDays.add(day);\n                }\n                CompoundTag ordinalTags = playerTag.getCompoundOrEmpty(\"sign_in_ordinals\");\n                for (String dayKey : ordinalTags.keySet()) {\n                    try {\n                        record.signInOrdinals.put(Long.parseLong(dayKey), ordinalTags.getIntOr(dayKey, 0));\n                    } catch (NumberFormatException ignored) {\n                        // Ignore malformed day keys.\n                    }\n                }\n                record.totalDays = playerTag.getIntOr(\"total_days\", record.signedDays.size());\n                record.streakDays = playerTag.getIntOr(\"streak_days\", 0);\n                record.lastSignedDay = playerTag.getLongOr(\"last_signed_day\", Long.MIN_VALUE);\n                data.players.put(playerId, record);\n            } catch (IllegalArgumentException ignored) {\n                // Ignore malformed records so one bad player cannot prevent a world from loading.\n            }\n        }\n\n        CompoundTag signerTags = root.getCompoundOrEmpty(DAILY_SIGNERS_KEY);\n        for (String key : signerTags.keySet()) {\n            try {\n                data.dailySigners.put(Long.parseLong(key), signerTags.getIntOr(key, 0));\n            } catch (NumberFormatException ignored) {\n                // Ignore malformed day keys.\n            }\n        }\n        return data;\n    }\n\n    private static CompoundTag toTag(CheckinData data) {\n        CompoundTag root = new CompoundTag();\n        CompoundTag playerTags = new CompoundTag();\n        for (Map.Entry<UUID, PlayerRecord> entry : data.players.entrySet()) {\n            PlayerRecord record = entry.getValue();\n            CompoundTag playerTag = new CompoundTag();\n            long[] signedDays = record.signedDays.stream().mapToLong(Long::longValue).toArray();\n            playerTag.putLongArray(\"signed_days\", signedDays);\n            playerTag.putInt(\"total_days\", record.totalDays);\n            playerTag.putInt(\"streak_days\", record.streakDays);\n            playerTag.putLong(\"last_signed_day\", record.lastSignedDay);\n            CompoundTag ordinalTags = new CompoundTag();\n            for (Map.Entry<Long, Integer> ordinalEntry : record.signInOrdinals.entrySet()) {\n                ordinalTags.putInt(Long.toString(ordinalEntry.getKey()), ordinalEntry.getValue());\n            }\n            playerTag.put(\"sign_in_ordinals\", ordinalTags);\n            playerTags.put(entry.getKey().toString(), playerTag);\n        }\n        root.put(PLAYERS_KEY, playerTags);\n\n        CompoundTag signerTags = new CompoundTag();\n        for (Map.Entry<Long, Integer> entry : data.dailySigners.entrySet()) {\n            signerTags.putInt(Long.toString(entry.getKey()), entry.getValue());\n        }\n        root.put(DAILY_SIGNERS_KEY, signerTags);\n        return root;\n    }\n\n    public record PlayerStats(boolean signedToday, int todayOrdinal, int totalDays, int streakDays) {\n    }\n\n    public record SignInResult(boolean newlySigned, PlayerStats stats) {\n    }\n\n    private static final class PlayerRecord {\n        private final Set<Long> signedDays = new HashSet<>();\n        private final Map<Long, Integer> signInOrdinals = new HashMap<>();\n        private int totalDays;\n        private int streakDays;\n        private long lastSignedDay = Long.MIN_VALUE;\n    }\n}\n\r\n\n---D:\\mod\\qiandao\\src\\main\\java\\dev\\modmind\\qiandao\\CheckinScreen.java---\r\npackage dev.modmind.qiandao;\n\nimport com.mojang.blaze3d.pipeline.RenderPipeline;\nimport locally.\n        if (!(player instanceof ServerPlayer serverPlayer) || ownerId == null\n                || !ownerId.equals(serverPlayer.getUUID())) {\n            return;\n        }\n        if result.stats().todayOrdinal()), true);\n        } else {\n            serverPlayer.displayClientMessage(Component.translatable(\"message.qiandao.already_signed\"), true);\n        }\n    }\n\n date.lengthOfMonth();\n        for (int day = 1; day <= DATE_SLOT_COUNT; day++) {\n            ItemStack stack;\n            if (day <= daysInMonth) {\n                LocalDate slotDate = date.withDayOfMonth(day);\n                boolean signed = data.hasSigned(owner.getUUID(), slotDate.toEpochDay());\n                stack = new ItemStack(signed ? Items.ENCHANTED_BOOK : Items.BOOK);\n                if (signed) {\n                    stack.set(DataComponents.ENCHANTMENT_GLINT_OVERRIDE, true);\n                }\n                stack.set(DataComponents.CUSTOM_NAME, Component.translatable(\n                        \"gui.qiandao.day\", day).withStyle(signed ? ChatFormatting.GREEN : ChatFormatting.WHITE));\n                String statusKey;\n                if (day == date.getDayOfMonth()) {\n                    statusKey = signed ? \"gui.qiandao.status.signed\" : \"gui.qiandao.status.today\";\n                } else if (day < date.getDayOfMonth()) {\n                    statusKey = signed ? \"gui.qiandao.status.signed\" : \"gui.qiandao.status.missed\";\n                } else {\n                    statusKey = \"gui.qiandao.status.future\";\n                }\n                stack.set(DataComponents.LORE, new ItemLore(List.of(\n                        Component.translatable(\"gui.qiandao.date\", date.getMonthValue(), day),\n                        Component.translatable(statusKey))));\n            } else {\n                stack = new ItemStack(Items.GRAY_STAINED_GLASS_PANE);\n                stack.set(DataComponents.CUSTOM_NAME, Component.translatable(\"gui.qiandao.empty\"));\n            }\n            checkinContainer.setItem(day - 1, stack);\n        }\n\n        for (int slot = DATE_SLOT_COUNT; slot < CONTAINER_SIZE; slot++) {\n            if (slot != PROFILE_SLOT) {\n                ItemStack filler = new ItemStack(Items.GRAY_STAINED_GLASS_PANE);\n                filler.set(DataComponents.CUSTOM_NAME, Component.translatable(\"gui.qiandao.empty\"));\n                checkinContainer.setItem(slot, filler);\n            }\n        }\n\n        ItemStack profile = new ItemStack(Items.PLAYER_HEAD);\n        profile.set(DataComponents.PROFILE, ResolvableProfile.createResolved(owner.getGameProfile()));\n        profile.set(DataComponents.CUSTOM_NAME, Component.translatable(\"gui.qiandao.profile\", owner.getName()));\n        String Click only today's slot to\n-check in; the server validates the slot index and records the result in persistent\n-world data. A checked day is shown as an enchanted book, and an unchecked day as a\n-regular book. Hover the player head in the center of the bottom row to see today's\n-ordinal, total check-ins, and current streak.\n+- Minecraft Java 版 `1.21.11`\n+- Fabric Loader `0.19.3` 或更高版本\n+- Fabric API `0.141.6+1.21.11`（或与当前游戏版本匹配的兼容版本）\n+- Java `21` 或更高版本\n \n-The current date is determined by the server JVM's system time zone.\n+这是一个同时包含服务端和客户端入口的模组。连接服务器的客户端也需要安装本模组及其依赖。\n+\n+## 安装\n+\n+1. 安装与 Minecraft `1.21.11` 匹配的 Fabric Loader、Fabric API 和 Java 21。\n+2. 从 `build/libs` 获取 `qiandao-<版本>.jar`，或使用下方的构建命令生成该文件。\n+3. 将模组 JAR 放入客户端和服务器的 `mods` 目录。\n+4. 启动游戏或服务器，并确认 Fabric API 已一同加载。\n+\n+## 使用方法\n+\n+在游戏中输入以下任意命令打开签到界面：\n+\n+```text\n+/qiandao\n+/qiandao open\n+/checkin\n+```\n+\n+打开界面后：\n+\n+1. 前四行显示当月日期。小于当月实际天数的格子会显示为灰色玻璃板。\n+2. 点击当天日期的格子完成签到。点击其他日期、空白格或使用非普通点击方式不会完成签到。\n+3. 签到成功后，当天格子会变为附魔书，并在聊天栏提示当天签到序号。\n+4. 将鼠标悬停在底部中央的玩家头像上，可查看当天序号（未签到时显示预计序号）、累计签到天数和连续签到天数。\n+\n+签到由服务器根据服务器 Java 虚拟机的系统时区确定日期。跨越午夜后，已打开的界面会在下一次交互时刷新为新的一天。连续签到按自然日计算；漏签后再次签到会从 1 天重新开始。\n+\n+## 构建\n+\n+项目使用 Gradle Wrapper，无需单独安装 Gradle。在项目根目录执行：\n+\n+```bash\n+# Linux/macOS\n+./gradlew build\n+\n+# Windows PowerShell\n+.\\gradlew.bat build\n+```\n+\n+构建产物位于 `build/libs/`：\n+\n+- `qiandao-<版本>.jar`：可安装的模组文件\n+- `qiandao-<版本>-sources.jar`：源代码包\n+\n+清理后重新构建可执行 `clean build`。项目当前没有自动化测试用例，构建任务会完成 Java 编译、资源处理和 JAR 重映射检查。\n+\n+## 项目结构\n+\n+```text\n+src/main/java/dev/modmind/qiandao/\n+├── ModMindEntry.java       # 模组初始化与命令注册\n+├── ModMindClient.java      # 客户端界面注册\n+├── CheckinScreenHandler.java # 签到菜单、槽位和服务器校验\n+├── CheckinScreen.java      # 签到界面渲染\n+└── CheckinData.java        # 世界持久化签到数据\n+\n+src/main/resources/assets/qiandao/\n+├── lang/zh_cn.json         # 简体中文文本\n+└── lang/en_us.json         # 英文文本\n+```\n+\n+## 数据与隐私\n+\n+签到记录保存在世界存档的 Minecraft `SavedData` 中，按玩家 UUID 区分玩家，并记录每天的签到状态、当天签到序号、累计天数和连续天数。模组不会向外部服务上传玩家数据。\n+\n+## 许可证\n+\n+本项目使用 [MIT License](LICENSE) 发布。\nwarning: in the working copy of 'README.md', LF will be replaced by CRLF the next time Git touches it\nwarning: in the working copy of 'docs/idea.md', LF will be replaced by CRLF the next time Git touches it\nwarning: in the working copy of 'README.md', LF will be replaced by CRLF the next time Git touches it\n","exit_code":0,"status":"completed"}}
